posts.author: Inbestor
posts.text: Aasulv og Sverre 😎 Superstrong quarter, Scandinavia strikes back First the facts: Volume: Growth 41% in LCY driven by UK and Norway. Wow CR: 82.7% with Norway and Sweden around 70% and UK with a "high" 90% for once ROI: 1.4% despite bond return at 0.2%. Running yield at 5.7% is 70 bp up from last year despite reduced risk  EPS/dividend: 10.2 NOK EPS and dividend at 5.0 NOK SCR: 231% (which is too high) Conclusion: another superstrong quarter. The perspective is even more interesting.
